title: The orchestrator fills the measured execution cost for the carry and arbitrage families
statement: When an enabled family declares InputNeed.COST (basis trade, funding carry, cross-exchange), Orchestrator._build_portfolio_inputs sets PortfolioInputs.execution_cost from measurements only: the per-leg fee from this symbol's recent closed trades in the timeframe's trading mode (both legs' fee over both legs' notional, at least MIN_FEE_SAMPLES trades, cached for _COST_FEE_TTL_S), half the quoted width of the live order book, and SlippageModel's calibrated square-root impact for the largest cost-family capital fraction of the executor's equity against the daily volume of the last 20 completed bars. If any of these cannot be measured (too few closed trades, a one-sided, crossed or unavailable book, too few bars, no equity, no executor, a failed read) the cost stays None and the families abstain; no configured or published number replaces it.
failure_mode: REG-1704 made the three families abstain without a measured cost, but nothing in production ever filled PortfolioInputs.execution_cost, so they could never trade and no test noticed: the strategy tests built the cost by hand and the orchestrator tests never asserted it. The deciding test drives _build_portfolio_inputs with stub storage, book and executor and checks each component and each fail-closed case.
